metadata.title: A class of generalised Killing spinors determined by the Ricci tensor and the metric
metadata.abstract: We introduce a class of generalised Killing spinors, termed affine Killing spinors (AKS), for which the associated endomorphism is a constant linear combination of the Ricci endomorphism and the identity map. We classify Riemannian spin manifolds admitting an AKS under two additional curvature hypotheses: harmonic curvature and local conformal flatness. Furthermore, we characterise Riemannian spin manifolds that admit a non-zero parallel one-form and an AKS. Additionally, we prove that in dimension three every curvature-homogeneous manifold carrying an AKS is locally homogeneous. Finally, we provide a complete classification of three-dimensional Lie groups equipped with a Bianchi metric admitting an invariant AKS.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Ricci 决定的广义 Killing 旋量分类
analysis.workSummary: 引入关联自同态为 Ricci 自同态与恒等映射常系数组合的 affine Killing 旋量，在调和曲率或局部共形平坦条件下分类，并刻画平行一形式情形及三维不变 Bianchi 度量。
analysis.breakthrough: 把若干曲率受限的旋量几何统一到同一仿射 Ricci 条件。
analysis.limitations: 一般维分类带额外曲率假设；三维曲率齐性推出局部齐性限于携带该类旋量的流形。
